recommended.t: Some food for all levels to heal from the acid
80 Constitution to get optional 30,000 Constitution experience (this reward can be collected later, after reaching level 80)

kills.t: The players will need to defend against low-level enemies.

rewards.l: Constitution XP lamp (Song from the Depths)

rewards.t: Remora's necklace (Providing unlimited teleportation to the Queen Black Dragon and Mature grotworms)
Reduced incoming damage when fighting the Queen Black Dragon (with 60 Summoning)

steps.t: Talk to Lucille who is in a house west of the Rimmington well. [Chat: 1 Is everything okay? › 1 Can I help? › Accept]
p: Following Waylan's soul into the cave

steps.t: Stay within Lucille's house and drink the restless sleep potion.
Follow the souls north-east to a cave entrance located south of the Rimmington mine and north-west of the Port Sarim lodestone and enter it.

sub.t: If you go past the cave, exit to the lobby, or logout in the cave, you will have to go back to Lucille and obtain the potion once again.

p: The Raptor waits inside the cave.

steps.t: Go north over the bridge.
Continue through the cave to the east.
Talk to the Raptor. [Chat: 1 I'm here to save Waylan.]
Enter the door to follow the Raptor.
Enter the north door.
Enter the west door.
Enter the south door.
Enter the east door.
Follow the souls and enter the final door to the north.
After the cutscene, go to the north-east corner of the room to discover the first symbol. It is two steps south of the wall feature against the north wall and two steps east of the fissure.
p: The spirits walking towards the next room
An illuminating symbol after it is found

steps.t: Head to the north-west corner where the second symbol will be located a bit south-west of the wavy section of the ground.
Enter the sparkling doorway that just appears. The location will be different for each player.
Go just west of the central fissure to find the first symbol.
Go west of the northern fissure to find the second symbol.
The last symbol is just north-west of the eastern fissure.
Enter the sparkling doorway that just appears. The location will be different for each player.
Follow the souls and enter the door to the north.
Take the burning sapling from the centre of the room and plant it in the pot overflowing with water to the southwest.
Enter the doorway with a waterfall to the northeast.
Take the dead sapling from the previous pot and plant it in the pot with living fungi to the northwest.
Enter the doorway surrounded by fungus to the southwest.
Take the budding sapling from the previous pot and plant it in the pot with ivy growing around it to the southeast.
Enter the doorway surrounded by ivy to the west.
Take the healthy sapling from the previous pot and plant it in the pot covered in cobwebs to the northeast.
Enter the doorway covered in cobwebs to the east.
Proceed north and enter the doorway.
After the cutscene, jump into the chasm.

Proceed through the three passageways and enter the openings whilst evading the acid, players with high life points or some food can simply run through the acid taking the shortest route to save time. Running straight through the acid deals some (2-15) damage. Use Surge and Dive when available.

After an interactive cutscene, finish the dialogue with the siren, Remora. [Chat: 1 We're not on an island. › 1 What you're talking about isn't real. › 2 Don't you know how you got here? › 2 You have been stealing the souls of villagers. › 1 Alright. › 1 Wait, don't kill her! › 1 We need her to escape.]
p: Bursting the sac Remora is contained in
The Queen Black Dragon spitting you, Remora and the Raptor out
Remora being killed by the Queen Black Dragon
The Raptor blocking the dragonfire from the Queen Black Dragon

steps.t: Talk to the Raptor. You will receive 3 items. [Chat: 2 What now? › 2 We should talk to Lucille.]
Head south-west to Rimmington and talk to Lucille.
Quest complete!
